title: Sheba's Rebellion and Joab's Murder of Amasa
description: The Benjamite Sheba, son of Bichri, blows the trumpet and leads Israel's men in rebellion against King David. David sends Amasa to gather Judah's men, but when he is delayed, the king sends Abisai and Joab with the warriors. At the great stone in Gibeon they meet Amasa. Joab pretends to greet him warmly, seizes his beard as if to kiss him, and stabs him in the belly so that his entrails spill out. Then Joab and Abisai continue the pursuit of Sheba [ref:2 Sam 20:1-13|2 Samuel 20:1-13].
